usage_boundary: Reference Lab examples only; an adopter may evaluate them separately without making them runtime enforcement.
stable_id_policy: Check IDs are permanent within v1; retire IDs rather than reuse them.

checks.name: configured-metadata
checks.purpose: Report missing metadata fields only when an adopter explicitly configures them for the relevant document role; this remains report-only.

checks.name: last-verified
checks.purpose: Report configured last_verified metadata that is missing, invalid, or outside an adopter-defined review interval; it is report-only and does not prove current runtime behavior.

checks.name: unresolved-placeholder
checks.purpose: Report unresolved template placeholders while allowing ordinary inline HTML.

checks.name: ephemeral-work-reference
checks.purpose: Report references to ephemeral activated .work content outside configured allowances; it does not make .work product truth.

checks.name: local-link-target
checks.purpose: Report missing local link targets and links that escape the adopted project root.

checks.name: local-link-anchor
checks.purpose: Report fragments that do not resolve to a heading anchor in the local target.

checks.name: required-navigation
checks.purpose: Report missing configured navigation files or required navigation links.

checks.name: generated-projection
checks.purpose: Reference Lab only: report missing, ambiguous, or stale configured generated projections without making them an independent authority.
